+"""Live API demo — hits the running uvicorn server."""
+import json
+import sys
+import urllib.request
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.error
+
+BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
+
+
+def req(method, path, body=None, token=None, timeout=30):
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    if token:
+        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
+    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
+    r = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}{path}", data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=timeout) as resp:
+            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read().decode() or "null")
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
+        return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or "null")
+
+
+def hr(c):
+    return "\n" + "─" * 60 + f"\n  {c}\n" + "─" * 60
+
+
+def main():
+    print("=" * 60)
+    print("  SWA ERP — LIVE API DEMO (working product)")
+    print("=" * 60)
+
+    print(hr("1. Health check"))
+    code, body = req("GET", "/healthz")

+    print(hr("4. List projects"))
+    code, body = req("GET", "/api/projects", token=token)

+    for p in body.get("items", []):
+        print(f"  • {p['business_id']} | {p['name']} | milestone={p['milestone']} | status={p['status']}")

def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
    return str(path), mime


def create_drn(
    db: Session,
    doc_type: str,
    date: datetime,
    associated_project_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    associated_token_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    author_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    document_nature: str = "Internal",
    intended_user: str = "Internal",
    description: str = "",
    revision: str = "R0",
    status: str = "Draft",
    remarks: str | None = None,
    file_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    original_filename: str | None = None,
) -> DRN:
    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)

    file_path = None
    if file_bytes and original_filename:
        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)

    drn = DRN(
        drn_code=drn_code,
        doc_type=doc_type,
        date=date,
        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
        author_id=author_id,
        document_nature=document_nature,
        intended_user=intended_user,
        description=description,
        revision=revision,
        status=status,
        remarks=remarks,
        file_path=file_path,
    )
    db.add(drn)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def list_drns(
    db: Session,
    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:

    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    db: Session,
    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
    **kwargs,
) -> DRN | None:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    for key, value in kwargs.items():
        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
            setattr(drn, key, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return False

    drn.is_deleted = True
    db.commit()
    return True


def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> DRN | None:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None

    drn.status = new_status
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(drn)
    return drn


def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
    if not drn:
        return None
    return drn.file_path

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric


def list_sustainability(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[SustainabilityMetric], int]:
    query = db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            SustainabilityMetric.reference_id.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.compliant_with_green_standards.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.notes.ilike(search)
        )

    if reference_kind:
        query = query.filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_kind == reference_kind)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(SustainabilityMetric.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.id == sustainability_id, SustainabilityMetric.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def get_by_reference_id(db: Session, reference_id: str) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_id == reference_id).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    reference_id: str,
    reference_kind: str,
    measured_at: date,
    insulation_efficiency_status: str,
    compliant_with_green_standards: str | None = None,
    total_energy_saved_kwh: float | None = None,
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: float | None = None,
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: float | None = None,
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: float | None = None,
    payback_period_months: int | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability = SustainabilityMetric(
        reference_id=reference_id,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
        compliant_with_green_standards=compliant_with_green_standards,
        total_energy_saved_kwh=total_energy_saved_kwh,
        co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e=co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        lifecycle_cost_savings_inr=lifecycle_cost_savings_inr,
        insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected=insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected,
        insulation_efficiency_status=insulation_efficiency_status,
        payback_period_months=payback_period_months,
        measured_at=measured_at,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(sustainability)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def update(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def soft_delete(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability
